lines.text: Out of the depths the writer cries to the LORD and asks Him to hear his plea for mercy.
Nobody could stand if the LORD kept track of iniquities, but with Him there is forgiveness.
The writer waits for the LORD and says his soul waits more than watchmen wait for the rain.
The writer tells Israel to hope in the LORD, who will redeem Israel from all iniquity.
David says his heart is not tired, and his soul is stilled like a weaned child with his mother.
